## Industry performance | Economic performance of the automotive industry in 2021

Published: 2022-01-12 Source: Industry Information Department, CAAM

According to China Association of Automobile Manufacturers statistical analysis, 2021 vehicle production and sales grew year over year, ending three consecutive years of decline since 2018. New energy vehicles were the biggest bright spot, with full-year sales exceeding 3.5 million units and market share rising to 13.4%, further demonstrating that the new energy vehicle market has shifted from policy-driven to market-pulled; driven by factors such as the recovery of international markets and improving competitiveness of Chinese brands, China's vehicle exports performed strongly, repeatedly setting new records from April onwards, with annual exports exceeding 2 million units for the first time - a breakthrough after hovering around 1 million units for many years; boosted by new energy and favourable export markets, Chinese-brand vehicles' market share has passed 44%, close to its best level ever.
